query: SELECT c.id, c.devedorId, c.condominioId, c.nossoNumero, c.status, c.statusRemessa, c.amount, c.dueDate, d.name as devedorNome FROM cobrancas c LEFT JOIN devedores d ON c.devedorId = d.id WHERE c.statusRemessa = 'remessa_gerada' OR c.status = 'em_cobranca' ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 20;
